status: Premerge acceptance passed; production receipt is recorded separately after deployment
scope: Runtime art direction for the existing Webster browser game: lighting, atmosphere, coordinated materials, crisp mapped ground, bounded short grass and the game interface. This record does not claim a new scenery survey or a new scenery asset release.

sceneryIdentity.verification: The release descriptor and policy are byte-identical at the base and tested commits. The local manifest and network were independently rehashed for this record; the normal prebuild audit checked every declared scenery asset against the unchanged manifest.
sceneryIdentity.sourceMasterScope: The source-scene identity is retained from the unchanged validated release. This runtime-only evidence pass did not reopen or rehash the Blender master.

automatedTests.scopeNote: These are the candidate site tests, validator fixture tests and scoped town TypeScript check. No claim of a full-site TypeScript clean baseline is made.

localBrowserAcceptance.environment: Immutable local Astro build; representative fixed locations and real user-interface inputs

findings: Main Street charcoal asphalt preserves legible paint and clearer curb shape; cloudy sky, restrained warm/cool buildings and muted HUD read more cohesively.

Previously conspicuous pale grass spikes are gone; short dark blades blend with the mown lawn. At1280×850 they are intentionally subtle. Both close camera eyes are about5.7m from the car, targetsabout10m, within14m fade radius.
Reviewed actual WebKit Lakeside screenshot after GPU check; no missing or corrupt ground/material shader effect seen.
Underlying source massing and generic façades remain simplified; this is art-directed appearance, not a surveyed photoreal replica.
localVisualAcceptance.cameraScope: Main Street, Poland Street and Lakeside Avenue use settled representative views. The two close-grass views use temporary diagnostic cameras in the isolated test page; they do not change the car pose or the source application.

grassBudget.geometryEnabled: Automatic and High on desktop; disabled in Low and on mobile
grassBudget.placement: Deterministic world-space sites, eroded raw land-cover channels and height/normal sampling from actual loaded terrain triangles. No per-frame terrain raycasts.
grassBudget.resourceScope: Counts are implementation limits. Runtime byte figures in the local reports are allocation estimates, not OS or GPU memory measurements.

limitations: Layout, routes and source assets are retained, while colors, lighting, lawns and generic architectural appearance are authored or inferred. This is not a surveyed photoreal replica or an observation of every property.
The underlying simplified building massing and generic facades remain. Short grass is intentionally subtle at normal driving height and 1280 by 850 review resolution.
Local functional tests and visual captures do not establish hosted cold-start speed, sustained performance, physical-phone performance or production acceptance.
The normal asset audit validates declared content, containers and dependencies; exact decoded source-geometry evidence belongs to the existing immutable scenery release audit.
